# /plan — Copilot prompt file

Before you write a single edit, produce a one-page plan with this structure.

## Plan

**Goal.** One sentence — what success looks like.

**Files I'll touch.** A bulleted list with a 6-word reason for each.

**Files I'll read first.** Before editing anything.

**Risks.** Three things that could go wrong.

**Out of scope.** What I am explicitly NOT doing in this task.

**Done when.** A short checklist a human could verify in under a minute.

Stop after the plan. Wait for the user to say "go" before editing.
